import base64,runpy,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/kaggle/working/_work');p.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
files={'repro_core.py': '', 'repro_run.py': '', 'mech.py': ''}
for n,x in files.items(): (p/n).write_bytes(base64.b64decode(x))
sys.path.insert(0,str(p))
runpy.run_path(str(p/'mech.py'),run_name='__main__')
